Beodeul instead uses tinted dark material tones: the stall and well references measure 1% and 33% neutral, and the hedge 0%. Only the lamp-crook is neutral, and that is a thin metal pole. The candidate's materials (frame, glass panel, base) are each shaded in about 3 steps, against 5-6 on the stall and well. The panels are smooth, with little grain or speckle and no per-element highlights. At 11 visible tones per tile it is above the hedge (9) but well below the stall (17) and well (20). It is not heavily flat-filled (2% near-flat), but the structure reads as a clean, shallow sticker-style prop next to the references.
